chunks: Do not have intercourse at the beginning of the month, nor in its middle, nor at its end. For whoever does that should be prepared for miscarriage of the child; and if it is carried to term, it is likely to be mentally unstable. Do you not see that the insane are most often afflicted at the beginning of the month, its middle, and its end?

key_terms.سِقْطِ: miscarriage or loss of the fetus

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about disliked times for intercourse during the month?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام a discouragement of intercourse at the beginning, middle, and end of the month. It presents this as a makruh timing connected with possible harm to offspring, including miscarriage or mental instability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4408 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:

"Do not have intercourse at the beginning of the month, in its middle, or at its end. For whoever does so should prepare himself for the possibility of miscarriage.
And if the child is born, it is likely to suffer from mental instability.
Do you not see that most cases of insanity occur at the beginning, middle, and end of the month?"
